title: Bug ?? Connected to power but NS not uploading
symptom: When NS upload is set to 'when charging' only, and the phone is connected to power but battery is full, NS does not upload because the phone is not technically charging.
cause: The phone is not charging because the battery is full, so the condition 'when charging' is not met, even though it is connected to external power.
fix: MilosKozak made a small update to make connection status update faster, and mentioned uploading while fully charged, but no explicit fix is stated.
evidence_quote: Technically, the phone isn't charging (as the battery is full) but it is still connected to external power.
